tools.name: search_experiences
tools.description:
Search Phuket activities for a travel party. Returns a portfolio of ~4 diverse recommendations (max 8 via max_results) from ~1,900 real experiences.

**Portfolio, not top-k.** Each response contains one best-overall pick, alternative categories, and a wildcard/value option — all from distinct venues

tools.name: get_experience
tools.description: Get full details for a specific experience by ID — prefer this for follow-up questions about products returned by search_experiences (pass its experience_id). findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "search_experiences" stacks urgency/override words (important, always, ignore). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
